scope: C1 exploratory expectation-first fiscal plus macro gold flow filter above existing B actual execution

gold_source.source: GC=F Yahoo 1h grouped 4h; previous 2025-2026 research window

shared_risk_and_costs.gold: Yahoo continuous GC=F hourly to five-slot 4h New York evening sessions
shared_risk_and_costs.A_exposure: 1x gold long fully invested from start to end (no leverage/rebalancing)
shared_risk_and_costs.B_exposure: Cash unless strict confirmed Dow daily AND weekly swing trend equals 4h breakout; 0.5pct risk / trade, 5x cap

C1_guardrail.type: EXPLORATORY PROXY C1, not real original V2.2 or untouched backtest
C1_guardrail.mode: anticipation; D+3 expected TGA not same-day Z-score gate
filter_definition: Fiscal D+3 is Treasury auction known components + historical imputed unannounced Bill gross issue + public cashflow residual; C1 research proxy
Fiscal observable at previous decision calendar date 23:59:59Z; entry at gold 4h later, never use future DTS cash outcome
All 12 FRED/DXY/GLD/CFTC/TGA sources use lagged observation timestamps, NOT certified revision/as-published data vintages
7-day DXY real yield and GLD changes and 28-day CFTC changes chosen as simple transparent pre-set rules, NOT optimized
SOFR-IORB spread <=0.20 pp adopted as a coarse research stress guardrail, NOT Fed/NYFed stress certification
CFTC managed money weekly and GLD physical inventory are NOT COMEX daily contract OI or global ETF dollar flows
Fiscal adverse threshold +30bn USD and supportive -30bn USD are unvalidated fixed sensitivity choices
Macro signs/flow signs and portfolio results studied on same 2025-2026 development sample; no untouched testing
Completeness of ON RRP reserve and TGA SOURCE data does not establish source is economically directionally supportive
C1 filters are not original gold V2.2 A/A+/A++ validated trading criteria; LIVE trade disabled

requirements_not_proven: Historical as-published Fiscal D+1/3/5 expectation path and surprise/revision vintage
DTS announcement tax-spending forecast and TreasuryDirect publicly-held net new cash identity
Actual available TGA buffers, Fed/SOMA, ON RRP, SRF, reserve and SOFR-IORB regime at every candidate
Policy vs fiscal-credit reprice split for real rates and DXY
GLD actual cash creations/redemptions rather than proxy tonnes and COMEX trade-day contract OI volume
Certified official daily and weekly Dow settles versus partial 4h constructed proxies
Specific GC futures roll, OHLC intrabar slippage and broker costs

precision_warnings: Do not report C1 as measured complete official V2.2 C2 strategy: several factors are proxy and original announcement release vintages missing
C1 policies were predeclared in code but NOT true untouched preregistration; this development window previously analyzed
All alternative variants are reported even if some yield zero trades; no cherry-picked winner
B and C1 use identical A/B simulator, broker proxy 10bps roundtrip, 0.5% risk, ATR stop and next-open entry
C1 tests filter only B-style confirmed Dow and 4h candidates; original C2 independent macro-led entry opportunities may be missed
Treasury forecast D+3 is an estimated cashflow path with historical imputed unannounced gross bill sales
DXY/real yield current-vintage and GLD holdings weekly CFTC proxy lag assumptions not certified as-published
Missing GLD source or CFTC/monetary source blocks C1 signals rather than treating missing observations as bullish
11 B trades are a small overlapping in-sample research ledger; no reliable causal lift or next-year forecast
